crop.notes: A 'Tips. Local and Elsewhere' sports column of unrelated items (baseball, billiards, pedestrian whip, Muldoon); only the last paragraph, Billy Madden's remarks, mentions Allen.

ocr.notes: Readable; 'eyesore we match' should be 'Ryan-Sullivan match', 'palmy or.' should be 'palmy days.'

title.suggested: Billy Madden Says Sullivan Could Have Beaten Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat quoted Sullivan's trainer Billy Madden calling Tom Allen a first-class man and a hard hitter, but saying the Boston Boy could have whipped him in his palmy days.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, March 2, 1882', page 6.

notes: Only an opinion of Allen by Madden; no events, travel or Allen quotes, so no facts recorded.
